title: plugin-form: record:line_items hydrates an identity-only column from the child field (label, type, options) as the master-detail carriers do, so printed line-item headings translate (the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#24140)
body:
Filing gate ④: the objectui layer of a cross-layer card. This card is the renderer half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#24140 (p1, `target:v18`, `domain:spec`), and that card keeps the spec half (the `RecordLineItemsProps.columns` describe). Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) when it graded #24140 route B. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24140

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat that claims it once #24140's spec PR merges. The landing is `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx`.

## Why

- A `record:line_items` table, on screen and on a print page, heads each column with the author's literal `label`, or with the bare field name when the column is identity-only (`{ name }`). In a zh-CN tenant, a printed invoice has English line-item headings under translated section headings (measured by objectstack #23985's dev, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24139, `open_questions[0]`).
- The master-detail carriers already hydrate an identity-only column from the child object's field through `hydrateColumns` (`packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts:305` on `origin/main`). Their headings translate through the existing `objects.CHILD.fields.F.label` keys.
- objectstack's shared `InlineGridColumnSchema.label` describe declares that default ("defaults to the child field's label via hydration"). #24140 makes `record:line_items` say the same.

## Done when

- `LineItemsPanel` fills an identity-only column's `label`, `type` and `options` from the bound child object's field, through the same `hydrateColumns`. ⛔ Not a second resolver.
- An authored `label` still wins. A column whose field the child object does not declare renders as today.
- Pins:
  - an identity-only column is headed by the child field's label, and under zh by its translation;
  - an authored label is kept;
  - ablating the hydration call turns the first pin red.
- objectstack picks this up through its next console pin move.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, `record:line_items column headings translate zh-CN label hydrate from child field`: 0 hits (the filer's search on #24140). On objectui, `LineItemsPanel record:line_items column label hydrate from child field translate`: 0 hits; `line items table column headings label`: 3 hits (#12705, #12110, #5351), all closed and none on this block.
